enchantments.tooltip: Quori Mind Shield: There are some benefits to being... connected. You are immune to Confusion and Domination effects, and gain a +23% Enhancement bonus to Chaos absorption.
Constitution +14: This item gives the wearer improved health, granting a +14 Enhancement bonus to Constitution.
Insightful Magical Sheltering +17: +17 Insight bonus to Magical Resistance Rating
Eversight: You benefit from the spell True Seeing and are Immune to Blindness.
Mythic Trinket Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
